svg.title: A4 print infographic poster design

g.text: Sensitivity, speed and cost of a card-sized assay, benchmarked against lab qPCR
Bench validation: 212 chips against lab qPCR, July to September 2026.
Field days: two pilot sites, two operators, 14 days in total.
Cost model: consumables at 10,000 units per year, supplier quotes.
Reagent lots: three, manufactured at one site.
Researcher A. et al. (2026) Lab-on-chip diagnostics: bench validation. Microfluidics Group.
